summary: Saint Jude is remembered as a steadfast apostle and witness to Christ’s love. He is invoked in times of desperation and serious need.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint Jude as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint Jude, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
